exporter_scale_query.positive_value_rule: retain finite strictly positive exporter-reported World exports
exporter_scale_query.no_export_rule: zero or missing exporter-reported World exports remain zero/missing and are not inferred from importer mirrors

importer_dependency_diagnostics.importer_denominator: 84 material importers defined by the prospectively frozen median positive-importer threshold
importer_dependency_diagnostics.partner_scope: official-Comtrade named country/area partners only for named-supplier diagnostics; residual/special partner areas remain separate
importer_dependency_diagnostics.largest_named_supplier_count: number of material importers for which the named partner has the largest named-country partner share
importer_dependency_diagnostics.threshold_counts: for each named supplier, count material importers whose all-reported bilateral denominator share from that supplier is at least the threshold
importer_dependency_diagnostics.residual_area_diagnostic: report Other Asia, nes (490) separately using the same 10/25/50 percent importer-share counts; never label it a named country supplier

ranking_outputs: top exporters by exporter-reported World HS8542 exports
top named suppliers by total importer-reported bilateral HS8542 value across material importers
top named suppliers by largest-named-supplier count
top named suppliers by material-importer dependency counts at 10, 25 and 50 percent
Other Asia, nes residual-area dependency counts reported separately
mirror_rule: Exporter-reported exports and importer-reported imports are distinct observations. They are never averaged, substituted, silently reconciled, or used to overwrite each other.
materiality_rule: Reuse the frozen importer materiality classification from the authoritative importer artifact; do not recompute a new importer threshold from exporter results.
tie_rule: Sort descending by the primary metric, then descending by trade value where applicable, then ascending by partner/reporter code for deterministic ties.
provenance: Record query parameters, UTC retrieval time, canonical response SHA-256, row counts, dataset checksum/classification verification, and official partner-reference provenance.
scientific_boundary: Exporter diagnostics measure reported commercial export scale and importer-side bilateral concentration. They do not identify fabrication origin, semiconductor production capacity, technological dependence, value added, or causal systemic importance. No exporter World values have been inspected at the time of this freeze.
